basic_profile.bio: Enthusiastic home barista and aspiring bushcraft adventurer. Recently got into the world of espresso making with my new Gaggia Classic Pro. Originally from the Pacific Northwest, I spend my weekends hiking and exploring nature. I work as a junior web developer, which allows me to have a flexible schedule. In a relationship with someone who shares my passion for coffee. Usually online in the evenings after work or during weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My coffee knowledge is self-taught, primarily through online forums and YouTube videos. I started with a simple pour-over setup before moving on to espresso. My interest in technology and my job in web development help me understand the technical aspects of espresso machines.
